full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white ink illustration centers a brooding man with small round glasses and interlaced hands against a turbulent field of smoke-like curls. He leans forward from the darkness, head lowered and eyes looking sharply upward beneath thick brows. His dark hair is swept back, with a few pale outlined strands falling across the forehead. The tiny round lenses shine nearly white, and the thin dark rims sit low on his nose. His nose and compressed mouth are modeled in stark black wedges and pale planes. Both hands meet immediately before the face, fingers crossing in a tight cluster that fills the center of the frame. The knuckles and long fingers carry careful gray hatching, and bright white shirt cuffs emerge from a nearly solid black jacket at the lower sides. A narrow white shirt opening and tiny button appear under the hands. The shoulders form a broad dark triangle stretching toward both lower corners. Behind and around the head, billowing gray textures and looping white ribbons twist through deep black. On the left, pale tendrils break across the dark shoulder; on the right, grayer curls make a dense vertical wall. Their source remains unseen, so they read as atmosphere rather than a clearly identified object. Fine dots, crosshatching, and irregular ink washes give the swirling background movement, while the face and hands remain more sharply defined. Light appears to strike the face and fingers from the upper left, leaving large areas of jacket and backdrop in absolute black. The overall composition is confrontational and theatrical, using one compact cluster of pale features within sweeping high-contrast darkness and energetic white curls.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白墨绘插画把一名戴小圆眼镜、双手交叉的沉思男子置于翻腾的烟雾状卷纹前。他从黑暗中向前探身，头低垂，眼睛却从浓眉下凌厉地向上看。深色头发向后梳，几缕有浅色轮廓的发丝落在额前。小小圆镜片几乎亮成白色，细深镜框低低架在鼻梁上。鼻子和紧抿的嘴由鲜明黑色楔形和浅色体面塑出。双手在脸前立即相接，手指紧密交错，占据画面中央。指节和细长手指带着仔细的灰色排线，亮白衬衫袖口从下方两侧近乎纯黑的外套中伸出。手下方还能看到一线白衬衣开口和小纽扣。肩膀形成宽阔深色三角形，伸向下方两角。头后及四周，翻卷灰色肌理与白色环绕曲线穿过深黑。左侧浅色卷须横切深色肩部；右侧较灰的卷纹形成密集竖向壁面。其来源不可见，所以更像气氛，而非能明确指认的物件。细小圆点、交叉排线和不规则墨色晕染让翻卷背景有动势，面孔与双手则保持更清楚的形。光似乎从左上方击中脸和手指，使外套与底面的大面积区域保持绝对黑。整体构图带有对峙感和戏剧性，在翻卷的高反差黑暗与活跃白色曲纹中放入一小簇浅亮五官与手部。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome ink illustration builds its drama from broad solid black, exposed white, and finely graduated gray. Dense dark masses anchor the lower frame, while pale sharp-edged passages and turbulent curling marks open around the focal center. Fine hatching, stippling, and irregular wash texture model selected surfaces without filling every area. Hard silhouette boundaries alternate with frayed, smoky transitions, so still geometric weight meets restless flowing line. Small bright planes attract the eye first; surrounding deep black preserves their clarity. The light is forcefully directional and selective, leaving large regions unlit rather than evenly describing all forms. Close framing and a triangular dark arrangement intensify the compact central contrast. The overall effect is suspenseful and graphic, with deliberate white space and animated ink texture carrying more emotion than color.
style_prompt_zh: 这种单色墨绘插画以宽阔实黑、外露白色和细致分级的灰色建立戏剧性。浓重深色体块锚定画面下方，浅亮锐边区域和翻腾卷曲痕迹则在焦点周围打开。细密排线、点触与不规则晕染有选择地塑造表面，没有填满每一处。硬剪影边界与散乱烟雾般的过渡交替，使静止几何重量碰上不安分的流线。小块亮面首先吸引视线，周围深黑保住其清晰。光照有力地定向且选择性很强，让大片区域不受光，而非平均交代所有形体。近距离取景和三角形深色布局加强紧凑的中央反差。整体效果悬念浓厚且图形性强，由审慎留白和活跃墨色肌理承担比色彩更多的情绪。
theme_en: A brooding man with round glasses and clasped hands amid curling monochrome smoke
theme_zh: 戴圆眼镜、双手交握的沉思男子处在翻卷的单色烟纹中
name: Dave Sim
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
